leaf: 有线手持浸入式料理棒多配件套装
name: 手持浸入式料理棒套装款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，把机身与整套配件在同一白底上交代清楚，建立套装价值感。
主图一秒法则：用仰势剖面与空白参数槽讲清动力这一第一购买理由。
机制解释：三行食材与空档位条并置，说明手感调速如何解决不同质地。
用同机位双栏与勾叉位证明工作端不伤锅，替代竞品对照主张。
代入备餐时刻并展示可换配件列，完成自我投射与配件可选教育。
把工具放进真实煮食动作里，用一锅成品完成场景说服。
微距证明释放结构与水冲即净，消除清洁顾虑。
以擦拭、置架、禁止浸水三格空白养护位降低使用与售后风险。
收口：以空白礼盒面与暖色节日虚化把套装转成送礼理由并促成下单。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless studio white #FFFFFF and cool steel plate #E4EBEF alternate with a deep graphite field #23292E; one warm beech worktop plane #C8A17A is reserved for the cooking scene and a soft ivory board #F4F1EC for the control-detail screen; every screen is a single flat material field, no gradient wash, no photographic wall scenery behind infographic copy
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in the amber-brass accent #C89B5A, rounded square chips, empty circled tick and cross markers, hairline arrow shapes with no lettering
style.lightingSystem: cool neutral studio light around 5600K, soft front-left key with a fill card, one defined rim along the metal body, clean contact shadows, no harsh speculars, no blown highlights on reflective shells
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium kitchen-appliance ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of studio white #FFFFFF, cool steel plate #E4EBEF, deep graphite field #23292E and one brushed amber-brass accent #C89B5A; cool neutral studio lighting around 5600K with a soft front-left key, fill card and a defined rim on the metal body; clean contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif kept off the image so bands stay empty; consistent thin single-weight line icon style in the amber-brass accent; brushed stainless and matte glass material language; stable product scale and centring across every screen; blank spec chips and empty callout slots instead of rendered copy; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented numbers.
style.presentationRules: the handheld unit stays upright at consistent scale across the set, its attachment family always reads as the same objects, people appear only from the chin down or from the wrist down, and no prop overlaps the drive end
style.surfaceSystem: matte studio board #F4F1EC, pale slate counter #D7DEE3, brushed stainless pot and bowl interiors, dark speckled stone top #2C3136, oiled beech worktop #C8A17A
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for any future overlay; all source copy removed so headline bands stay empty, blank chips and empty bar shapes only
